label: ⏳ Anomaly · rolling z-score
description: Flag time-series points whose distance from a rolling mean exceeds N standard deviations. Robust to slow drift (it's relative to the local window) and surfaces both isolated spikes and short bursts. Adds `zscore` and `is_anomaly` columns; doesn't drop rows so downstream steps decide what to do.

window.label: Rolling window (rows)
window.help: Number of rows behind each point used to compute the local mean + stddev. Larger window = slower to react but more stable baseline.

threshold.label: Z-score threshold (σ)
threshold.help: Points whose |z-score| exceeds this are flagged. 2σ ≈ 5% of normal data; 3σ ≈ 0.3%; 4σ ≈ 0.006%.

min_periods.label: Min observations to flag
min_periods.help: Don't flag the first N rows where the rolling stats haven't stabilized yet.
